facts.source_quote: 5. **nvALT plus a separately chosen Android file editor — current behavior is later evidence.** The [current project documentation](https://brettterpstra.com/projects/nvalt/) supports a Mac-side workflow using plain Markdown files, preview and tags. The page is explicitly updated in November 2026 and says the current 3.0 line removed Simplenote sync. A [2011 progress post](https://brettterpstra.com/2011/01/18/nvalt-1-0-8-progress/) confirms earlier Markdown-preview work but treats Simplenote tag sync as unfinished. I would not transfer the current feature set back to 2016.

This is my strongest starting point if the application already uses PostgreSQL. A unique key prevents two producer attempts from registering the same logical task; workers claim different pending rows transactionally. Completion must verify current ownership. Database results can be committed with the completion record; external operations need their own idempotency contract.
